thread:
tara (PM): Startup X asked for a "Latency Shield" packaging: separate cheap tier for embedding vs high-priority low-latency routes. They want per-route billing + hard usage limits in contract. Need decision on v1 scope.

kevin (Eng): Options: expose per-route billing tags + alerts (fast), or build hard enforcement at gateway (slower). Hard limits require durable counters and fast-path checks.

amy (Sales): They will sign only if hard contractual caps exist. Pilot can use soft caps but GA must have blocking.

tara (PM): Proposal: ship tagging + billing UI + soft caps as beta; commit to hard cap enforcement for GA with clear timelines.

otto (Legal): We'll draft Pilot language (AS-IS) and GA amendment with cap semantics and remedy terms. Need dispute window too.

jin (Solutions): Console needs a per-route toggle, cost preview, and an override flow for admins with audit trail. Demo expectations set.

ci-bot: feature-flag "route-billing-v1" enabled in staging.

kevin (Eng): Estimate: tagging + billing UI = 1 sprint; hard caps + quota infra = 4 sprints. Recommend v1 beta to meet pilot.

tara (PM): Action items: Kevin -> RFC for quota infra; Jin -> mock UI + cost estimator; Otto -> contract drafts; Amy -> secure pilot NDA and demo time. Sync Fri 9am.

amy (Sales): Confirmed pilot NDA pending. We'll aim for soft-cap demo next week. :thumbsup:
